info.title: TMF 622 Product Ordering
info.description: TMF API Reference : TMF 622 - Product Ordering Management**\\n\\n**Release : 19.0 - June 2019**\\n\\nThe Product Ordering API provides a standardized mechanism for placing a product order with all of the necessary order parameters.
